input: Source a local frame shop for large canvas prints

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the number of prints and their exact dimensions determines whether a small local framer can handle the job or if a specialist is needed.
The intended location (home, office, gallery, event) shapes requirements like mounting style, durability, and finish type.
Whether this is for personal use or a client/business changes the level of formality needed in vetting the shop (e.g., invoicing, bulk accounts).
Budget per frame and an overall spend cap directly filter which shops are viable options.
The deadline for having the framed prints ready affects whether a standard turnaround is acceptable or a rush service is required.
Frame style preferences (e.g., floating frame, gallery wrap, wood vs. metal) and finish choices narrow down which shops have the right materials and expertise.
Understanding what 'done well' means — lowest price, highest quality, fastest turnaround, or best reviews — determines how to rank and choose between candidate shops.

gold.taskTitle: Source a local frame shop for large canvas prints
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate a local frame shop capable of handling large canvas prints for an unspecified purpose.

questions.title: What are the dimensions of your largest canvas print?
questions.description: Identify the maximum size the frame shop must be able to accommodate, as very large formats require specialist equipment.

questions.title: Where will these framed prints be displayed?
questions.description: Determine the display environment (home, office, gallery, public venue) to guide requirements around mounting, finish, and durability.

questions.title: Is this for personal use or a client or business?
questions.description: Establish whether the sourcing is personal or commercial, which affects vetting criteria such as trade accounts, bulk pricing, and formal invoicing.

questions.title: What is your budget per framed print?
questions.description: Set a per-unit spend limit to filter out shops that fall outside the acceptable price range.

questions.title: When do you need the finished prints by?
questions.description: Clarify the deadline to determine whether standard turnaround times are sufficient or a rush service must be factored in.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred frame style or finish in mind?
questions.description: Identify any style preferences (floating frame, gallery wrap, wood, metal, matte, gloss) to narrow the shortlist to shops with the right materials and expertise.

questions.title: What matters most — price, quality, speed, or reputation?
questions.description: Establish the primary ranking criterion so the best-fit shop can be identified when trade-offs between candidates are required.
